summary: 2026-10-26 VLA-Radar V3.0 maintenance: deep-read and admit FocusVLA (p137) and Ropedia W0 (p138), audit source-scoped RoboTwin/Piper and FastWAM LIBERO-Plus author-reported metrics without conflating video PSNR or official benchmark leaderboard; add first-party Singapore NRP manufacturing challenge and HoloMotion SuperMimic Oct24 news; confirm p042 ICME author-lab acceptance but leave IEEE publishedAt/DOI unknown; preserve honest Oct26 partial four-lane discovery and bilingual news checkpoints at last complete Oct04; register resources/reproducibility and bounded dated source audits. Admin-only main protection remains unconfigured; avoid fabricated completion. The newly encountered Piper Real dataset is expressly classified a real-robot paper case study in benchmark quality and taxonomy; no new official leaderboard identity is inferred.
